initial_task: Triage today's inbox from the terminal and tell me what needs attention.

stages.observed_state: The task is inbox prioritization and thread-aware triage using a terminal mailbox connector.

stages.transition_trigger: An important email asks the user to schedule a meeting tomorrow at 3 PM, and the user approves creating the event.
stages.observed_state: The task has changed from email triage to a Google Calendar mutation derived from the email.

rationale: Email Inbox Triage explicitly classifies scheduling as an action-without-reply and delegates provider commands to connector Skills. Himalaya is appropriate for the initial terminal email work, while Google Workspace becomes newly required only when the task transitions to creating a Calendar event.

initial_task: Implement GitHub issue #42 and open a verified pull request.

stages.observed_state: The issue has been selected; the live issue/thread and repository instructions must be read, the premise validated, and the change implemented through a verified PR workflow.

stages.transition_trigger: CI fails with a reproducible Python test failure and traceback while the issue-to-PR work is still in progress.
stages.observed_state: A technical failure now blocks completion of the issue-to-PR workflow and requires root-cause investigation before any fix.

stages.transition_trigger: The traceback and ordinary logs are insufficient; the failing test is reproducible but the wrong runtime value must be inspected step-by-step inside Python execution.
stages.observed_state: The debugging process has narrowed the problem enough that interactive/runtime inspection of Python state is now necessary.

stages.transition_trigger: The bug is fixed, tests and CI pass, the PR has been opened, and the user now asks for a final review of the existing PR before merge.
stages.observed_state: The task has changed from implementing the issue to reviewing an existing pull request and its diff.

rationale: github-issue-to-pr owns the end-to-end issue-to-verified-PR workflow and explicitly loads systematic-debugging when the bug class calls for it. systematic-debugging becomes required when CI exposes a reproducible technical failure. python-debugpy is not required merely because a Python traceback exists; its own guidance says to use it when traceback/logging is insufficient and stepping or runtime-state inspection is needed, so it becomes newly required only at S3. github-code-review is reserved for the later task transition to reviewing an existing PR, which github-issue-to-pr explicitly says is outside its scope.
